transcript:
MARTIN: Damnit, damnit, damnit! 

[SFX: He dials. It goes straight to voicemail.]

DAVID (answering machine): You've reached David Scott. I can't make it to the phone right now, so please leave a message.

[MARTIN exclaiming stressed frustration]

[SFX: beep]
[AMBIENCE changes to phone comfort noise]
